title: nephrodium tibeticum
intro: Nephrodium tibeticum, commonly known as Himalayan maidenhair fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium tibeticum include reducing fever, alleviating respiratory issues, and acting as an antiseptic, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The plant's extracts have been studied for their potential in treating conditions such as cancer, diabetes, and cardiovascular diseases.
